product.olivetti-m6-460.summary: The 66 MHz DX2 configuration in the first M6 family covered by the guide.
product.olivetti-m6-460.history: Olivetti’s guide places the M6-460 in a line of four AT configurations. Its 66 MHz DX2 variant belonged to the same family as the M6-450.
product.olivetti-m6-460.architecture: Memory could grow without replacing the board. The guide records 4 MB soldered and three sequential SIMM sockets. The documented board is BA2002.
product.olivetti-m6-460.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records Flash EPROM · Rev. 1.20.
product.olivetti-m6-460.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m6-460.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-460.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, §37, pp. 37-1–37-3.
